# Vector-tail staging must not add guard padding: a float slice sum
# allocates exactly what a padding-free make of the same length
# allocates. Both per-call costs are measured in-program with GC off;
# the bare make is the padding-free oracle for the staging slice.
[!GOARCH:amd64] skip 'no-guard-padding probe needs amd64'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
env GOGC=off

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^pad32 0$'
stdout '^pad64 0$'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/noguardpadding

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"runtime"
)

var sinkF float32
var sinkD float64
var sinkS32 []float32
var sinkS64 []float64

func totalAlloc() uint64 {
	var m runtime.MemStats
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&m)
	return m.TotalAlloc
}

//go:noinline
func sumF32(xs []float32) float32 { return xs.sum() }

//go:noinline
func sumF64(xs []float64) float64 { return xs.sum() }

func main() {
	const K = 2000
	xs := make([]float32, 70)
	for i := range xs {
		xs[i] = float32(i)
	}
	xd := make([]float64, 70)
	for i := range xd {
		xd[i] = float64(i)
	}
	n := len(xs)
	a0 := totalAlloc()
	for i := 0; i < K; i++ {
		sinkF += sumF32(xs)
	}
	a1 := totalAlloc()
	b0 := totalAlloc()
	for i := 0; i < K; i++ {
		sinkS32 = make([]float32, n)
		sinkF += sinkS32[0] + sinkS32[n-1]
	}
	b1 := totalAlloc()
	c0 := totalAlloc()
	for i := 0; i < K; i++ {
		sinkD += sumF64(xd)
	}
	c1 := totalAlloc()
	d0 := totalAlloc()
	for i := 0; i < K; i++ {
		sinkS64 = make([]float64, n)
		sinkD += sinkS64[0] + sinkS64[n-1]
	}
	d1 := totalAlloc()
	fmt.Println("pad32", int64((a1-a0)/K)-int64((b1-b0)/K))
	fmt.Println("pad64", int64((c1-c0)/K)-int64((d1-d0)/K))
}
